'''Fitomp''' was an unaligned [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TUR" /> situated in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Fitomp system/Legends|Fitomp system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was a part of the [[Rakatan Archipelago]], a fragmented group of planets [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by tribes of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] after the collapse of the Rakatan [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]<ref name="TUR" /> around [[25,200 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Fitomp was also [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to another [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Unidentified Fitomp species|species]] that already inhabited it before the arrival of the Rakata.<ref name="TUR" />

Over the subsequent tens of [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]], the Rakatan tribe that colonized Fitomp regressed to a technologically primitive and barbarous state. Similarly to the Rakata that inhabited [[Hilak]], another world of the Rakatan Archipelago, the Fitomp tribe came to believe that their adopted homeworld constituted the entirety of creation. In addition, the Rakata on Fitomp engaged in warfare against the other sentient species of the planet. The state of the Fitomp and Hilak Rakata contrasted with the [[Makatak tribe|tribes]] [[Tulpaa tribe|inhabiting]] the worlds of [[Makatak]] and [[Tulpaa]], which had rediscovered the technology of interstellar [[Starship/Legends|spaceflight]].<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fitomp was introduced in the [[2010]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
